papers.title: DiMo-GUI: Advancing Test-time Scaling in GUI Grounding via Modality-Aware Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Hang Wu, Hongkai Chen, Yujun Cai, Chang Liu, Qingwen Ye, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Yiwei Wang
papers.tags: visual grounding, object detection, scene understanding, gui
papers.affiliations: 未明确（正文第一页显示：1University of California, Merced, 2The University of Queensland, 3vivo Mobile Communication Co., Ltd）
papers.intro: DiMo-GUI 是一个无需训练的即插即用框架，通过分离文本与图标模态、渐进式动态缩放和自适应停止机制，显著提升现有 GUI grounding 模型在复杂界面上的定位精度。

papers.title: Improving Personalized Search with Regularized Low-Rank Parameter Updates
papers.authors: Fiona Ryan, Josef Sivic, Fabian Caba Heilbron, Judy Hoffman, James M. Rehg, Bryan Russell
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image retrieval, CLIP, video search
papers.affiliations: Georgia Tech, Adobe Research, CIIRC CTU, UIUC
papers.intro: 论文提出POLAR方法，通过带有正则化的低秩参数更新（对文本编码器最后一层的value变换进行秩一LoRA更新）替代文本反演，实现个性化视觉语言检索，在保持通用知识的同时显著提升了检索准确率。

papers.title: Atomic-to-Compositional Generalization for Mobile Agents with A New Benchmark and Scheduling System
papers.authors: Yuan Guo, Tingjia Miao, Zheng Wu, Pengzhou Cheng, Ming Zhou, Zhuosheng Zhang
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Langboat Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出UI-NEXUS基准（系统定义三种组合操作类型，覆盖50个应用、100个任务模板）和AGENT-NEXUS调度系统（动态分解长程组合任务为原子子任务），将现有智能体在组合任务上的成功率提升24%–40%，同时保持推理成本可控。

papers.title: GUI-Actor: Coordinate-Free Visual Grounding for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Qianhui Wu, Kanzhi Cheng, Rui Yang, Chaoyun Zhang, Jianwei Yang, Huiqiang Jiang, Jian Mu, Baolin Peng, Bo Qiao, Reuben Tan, Si Qin, Lars Liden, Qingwei Lin, Huan Zhang, Tong Zhang, Jianbing Zhang, Dongmei Zhang, Jianfeng Gao
papers.affiliations: Microsoft, Nanjing University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
papers.intro: GUI-Actor是一种基于VLM的免坐标（coordinate-free）GUI视觉定位方法，通过引入注意力驱动的<ACTOR>令牌和动作头，直接从视觉patch中定位动作区域，避免了坐标生成的固有缺陷。

papers.title: AgentCPM-GUI: Building Mobile-Use Agents with Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Zhong Zhang, Yaxi Lu, Yikun Fu, Yupeng Huo, Shenzhi Yang, Yesai Wu, Han Si, Xin Cong, Haotian Chen, Yankai Lin, Jie Xie, Wei Zhou, Wang Xu, Yuanheng Zhang, Zhou Su, Zhongwu Zhai, Xiaoming Liu, Yudong Mei, Jianming Xu, Hongyan Tian, Chongyi Wang, Chi Chen, Yuan Yao, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, OCR, edge deployment, gui
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University, Renmin University of China, ModelBest Inc
papers.intro: 提出AgentCPM-GUI（8B参数），通过三阶段渐进训练（感知预训练、有监督模仿学习、强化微调）并设计紧凑动作空间，在五个公开英文基准和新构建的中文基准CAGUI上达到最先进性能。

papers.title: SA-Person: Text-Based Person Retrieval with Scene-aware Re-ranking
papers.authors: Yingjia Xu, Jinlin Wu, Daming Gao, Zhen Chen, Yang Yang, Min Cao, Mang Ye, Zhen Lei
papers.tags: image retrieval, CLIP, multimodal learning, visual grounding, video search
papers.affiliations: Soochow University; Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Hong Kong Institute of Science and Innovation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Systems (MAIS), Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Wuhan University; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出场景感知文本行人检索范式，构建了大规模数据集ScenePerson-13W，并设计了两阶段框架SA-Person，通过外观接地和训练无关的SceneRanker重排序模块联合推理行人外观与全局场景上下文，显著提升复杂场景下的检索精度。

papers.title: ScienceBoard: Evaluating Multimodal Autonomous Agents in Realistic Scientific Workflows
papers.authors: Qiushi Sun, Zhoumianze Liu, Chang Ma, Zichen Ding, Fangzhi Xu, Zhangyue Yin, Haiteng Zhao, Zhenyu Wu, Kanzhi Cheng, Zhaoyang Liu, Jianing Wang, Qintong Li, Xiangru Tang, Tianbao Xie, Xiachong Feng, Xiang Li, Ben Kao, Wenhai Wang, Biqing Qi, Lingpeng Kong, Zhiyong Wu

papers.title: RemoteSAM: Towards Segment Anything for Earth Observation
papers.authors: Liang Yao, Fan Liu, Delong Chen, Chuanyi Zhang, Yijun Wang, Ziyun Chen, Wei Xu, Shimin Di, Yuhui Zheng
papers.affiliations: Hohai University, HKUST, Southeast University
papers.intro: 论文提出RemoteSAM，基于指代表达分割的任务统一范式，结合自动数据引擎构建270K语义丰富的数据集，在多个遥感感知基准上实现新的最先进结果，且参数量比现有基础模型少一个数量级。

papers.title: GUI-G1: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training for Visual Grounding in GUI Agents
papers.authors: Yuqi Zhou, Sunhao Dai, Shuai Wang, Kaiwen Zhou, Qinglin Jia, Jun Xu
papers.affiliations: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China; Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab
papers.intro: 论文系统分析了R1-Zero-like训练在GUI视觉定位中的三个关键挑战并提出对应解决方案（Fast Thinking模板、box尺寸约束奖励、修正GRPO目标），训练出的GUI-G1-3B模型仅用17K样本即超越大小相近甚至更大的模型，达到新SOTA性能。

papers.title: EVA: Evolving Semantic Adversaries for Red-Teaming GUI Agents Against Environmental Injection Attacks
papers.authors: Yijie Lu, Manman Zhao, Tianjie Ju, Zihe Yan, Xinbei Ma, Yuan Guo, Daizong Ding, Gongshen Liu, Zhuosheng Zhang

papers.title: Scaling Computer-Use Grounding via User Interface Decomposition and Synthesis
papers.authors: Tianbao Xie, Jiaqi Deng, Xiaochuan Li, Junlin Yang, Haoyuan Wu, Jixuan Chen, Wenjing Hu, Xinyuan Wang, Yuhui Xu, Zekun Wang, Yiheng Xu, Junli Wang, Doyen Sahoo, Tao Yu, Caiming Xiong

papers.title: EnronQA: Towards Personalized RAG over Private Documents
papers.authors: Michael J. Ryan, Danmei Xu, Chris Nivera, Daniel Campos
papers.affiliations: Stanford University（Michael J. Ryan，工作完成于Snowflake实习）；Snowflake（Danmei Xu, Chris Nivera, Daniel Campos）
papers.intro: 本文发布了一个基于Enron邮件语料的大规模私有文档问答基准EnronQA（103,638封邮件、528,304个问答对、150个用户收件箱），并基于该基准评测了RAG管道在私有文档上的性能，展示出检索相对于无检索和参数记忆的显著优势。

papers.title: LLM-Powered GUI Agents in Phone Automation: Surveying Progress and Prospects
papers.authors: Guangyi Liu, Pengxiang Zhao, Yaozhen Liang, Liang Liu, Yaxuan Guo, Han Xiao, Weifeng Lin, Yuxiang Chai, Yue Han, Shuai Ren, Hao Wang, Xiaoyu Liang, WenHao Wang, Tianze Wu, Zhengxi Lu, Siheng Chen, LiLinghao, Hao Wang, Guanjing Xiong, Yong Liu, Hongsheng Li

papers.title: TongUI: Internet-Scale Trajectories from Multimodal Web Tutorials for Generalized GUI Agents

papers.title: ScreenSpot-Pro: GUI Grounding for Professional High-Resolution Computer Use

papers.title: UI-Vision: A Desktop-centric GUI Benchmark for Visual Perception and Interaction
